channel.title: LocalClaw New Local AI Models
channel.description: Recently released open-weight AI models verified for local use in the LocalClaw catalogue.

item.title: LFM3 1.7B
item.description: Liquid AI tri-hybrid text model for multilingual chat, tool calling and structured outputs. Official Q4_K_M GGUF is 1.10GB. Plan for 8GB RAM at short context. Requires LFM3-enabled llama.cpp; not recommended for agentic coding or complex reasoning. 1.73B · 8 GB short-context RAM estimate · Q4_K_M · lfm.

item.title: LFM3 VL 2B
item.description: Liquid AI image understanding, OCR and visual reasoning model. Official QAD Q4_0 GGUF plus F16 vision projector totals 1.43GB. Plan for 8GB RAM at short context. Requires LFM3-enabled llama.cpp; video input is not yet supported. 1.92B · 8 GB short-context RAM estimate · Q4_0 · lfm.

item.title: Nanbeige4.3 33B
item.description: Apache 2.0 English/Chinese coding and tool-use model from Nanbeige. Bartowski Q4_K_M GGUF is 20.79GB. Plan for 32GB RAM at short context; the 512K model limit needs substantially more memory. Use llama.cpp b11845 or newer. 33B (dense) · 32 GB short-context RAM estimate · Q4_K_M · nanbeige.

item.title: Recursive Flint 40B-A2.5B
item.description: Apache 2.0 coding-agent model trained from scratch by Recursive. ggml-org Q4_K_M GGUF is 23.39GB. Plan for 48GB RAM at short context; 262K is the model limit, not a memory guarantee. Requires a llama.cpp build with Flint support (PR 30928). 39.8B (2.5B active, MoE) · 48 GB short-context RAM estimate · Q4_K_M · flint.

item.title: Raon-1 mini preview
item.description: KRAFTON Apache 2.0 model trained from scratch, focused on Korean conversation and agentic tasks. Official Q4_K_M GGUF is 19.69GB. Plan for 32GB RAM at short context. Preview release requires the KRAFTON llama.cpp branch; 262K context needs separate memory planning. 28.8B (4.3B active, MoE) · 32 GB short-context RAM estimate · Q4_K_M · raon.

item.title: Spark-X2.6 4B
item.description: Official Apache 2.0 SparkLLM release for local chat, coding and tool use. Official Q4_K_M GGUF is 3.54GB. Plan for 8GB RAM at short context; the configured 1M-token maximum needs substantially more memory. Requires llama.cpp b10828+, Ollama 0.34.1+ or LM Studio 0.4.0+. 4.11B · 8 GB minimum RAM · Q4_K_M · spark.

item.title: NVIDIA Dory 1.0 4B
item.description: NVIDIA OpenMDW-1.1 open-weight reasoning model with recurrent layers and official 3.67GB Q5_K_M GGUF. The documented Apple Silicon setup uses a pinned Dory-enabled llama.cpp build and 4096-token context. Budget 16GB unified memory; the 256K model limit is not a 16GB memory guarantee. 4B · 16 GB minimum RAM · Q5_K_M · nemotron.

item.title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B
item.description: Liquid AI LFM2.5 reasoning MoE built for private on-device agents. The official LFM 1.0 release has 24B total / 2.45B active parameters, 131K context, official GGUF and MLX artifacts, and a 14.5GB Q4_K_M GGUF for laptop/workstation local use. 24B (2.45B active, MoE) · 24 GB minimum RAM · Q4_K_M GGUF · lfm.

item.title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 35B-A3B
item.description: OpenBMB Apache 2.0 MiniCPM-V 4.7 MoE release with image, multi-image and video understanding. Official Q4_K_M GGUF is about 21.2GB for workstation-class local multimodal use. 35B (3B active, MoE) · 32 GB minimum RAM · Q4_K_M · minicpm.

item.title: Mellum2.1 12B-A2.5B Thinking
item.description: Official JetBrains Apache 2.0 coding-reasoning MoE with 12B total parameters, about 2.5B active parameters, 131K context and official Q4_K_M GGUF for llama.cpp, Ollama and LM Studio-compatible local runtimes. 12B (2.5B active, MoE) · 16 GB minimum RAM · Q4_K_M · mellum.

item.title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 (1B)
item.description: OpenBMB Apache 2.0 compact vision-language model for images and video. The official 672MB Q4_K_M GGUF makes MiniCPM-V 4.7 1B practical on consumer laptops and edge devices. 1B · 8 GB minimum RAM · Q4_K_M · minicpm.

item.title: MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL
item.description: Official Xiaomi MiMo MIT-licensed sparse MoE with 309B total / 15B active parameters, native text-image-video-audio support, 1M-token context and ggml-org GGUF artifacts for llama.cpp-class workstation experiments. 309B (15B active, MoE) · 160 GB minimum RAM · Q2_K GGUF · mimo.

item.title: Xing4.0-29B-A4B
item.description: Official China Telecom XingChen-AGI Apache 2.0 MoE release with 29B total parameters, 4B active parameters, 256K native context and an official IQ4_NL GGUF path for llama.cpp-class local inference on 24GB GPU workstations. 29B (4B active, MoE) · 32 GB minimum RAM · IQ4_NL GGUF · xing.

item.title: Bonsai 2 27B
item.description: PrismML Apache 2.0 ternary Qwen3.8-27B derivative with official GGUF and MLX paths. The PQ2_0 pack is 7.21GB, PTQ1_0 is 5.95GB, and custom llama.cpp/MLX kernels target laptop-class local inference. 27.36B (ternary) · 16 GB minimum RAM · PQ2_0 · bonsai.

item.title: LLM-jp-4.1 32B-A3B Thinking
item.description: Official Apache 2.0 LLM-jp 4.1 sparse MoE reasoning model with 32B total / 3.8B active parameters, 65K context, Japanese-English post-training and an official Q4_K_M GGUF path for larger local workstations. 32B (3.8B active, MoE) · 48 GB minimum RAM · Q4_K_M · llm-jp.

item.title: Needle 3
item.description: Cactus Compute Apache 2.0 foundation model for tiny on-device tool calling, extraction and embeddings. Official `.cact` runtime artifacts run through the cactus-needle Python package, C API, browser/WASI and platform runners instead of stock GGUF or LM Studio. 121M laddered SAN · 1 GB minimum RAM · CQ2 .cact · needle.

item.title: LLM-jp-4.1 8B Thinking
item.description: Official Apache 2.0 LLM-jp 4.1 dense reasoning model from NII/LLM-jp with English/Japanese focus, 65K context, Harmony-style chat template and official Q4_K_M GGUF for local llama.cpp testing through the LLM-jp fork. 8B · 16 GB minimum RAM · Q4_K_M · llm-jp.

item.title: Occamy-1.0
item.description: Accio Lab Apache 2.0 co-work model post-trained from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B for long-horizon tools, files, code and business workflows. Official GGUF Q4_K_M is 19.7GiB with llama.cpp validation evidence. 35B (3B active, MoE) · 32 GB minimum RAM · Q4_K_M · occamy.

item.title: Nex-N2.5-mini
item.description: Official Nex-AGI Apache 2.0 multimodal agent model for computer use, web browsing, coding and tool calling. Community Q4_K_M GGUF is about 21.3GB with documented llama.cpp text and vision smoke tests. 35B MoE · 32 GB minimum RAM · Q4_K_M · nex.

item.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
item.description: Official MIT DeepSeek V4.1 Flash release with CED architecture, CSA2 attention, multimodal input and 1M-token context. Community GGUF artifacts include split Q2_K/Q3/Q4 builds plus a llama.cpp patch path; use only on 256GB+ workstations, with 384GB+ safer. 552B MoE (8B/16B active) · 256 GB minimum RAM · Q2_K · deepseek-flash.
